name: Abdominal dead bug
movement: Supine dead bug with hips and knees at 90 degrees, arms up; lower opposite arm and leg while keeping low back gently down, return and alternate.
cue: Deite com braços para cima e joelhos a 90 graus. Afaste braço e perna opostos sem tirar a lombar do chão e alterne.
